INSERT INTO canvas_digest_runs (
  course_count, 
  total_assignments_scanned, 
  unsubmitted_count, 
  due_soon_count, 
  slack_post_status,
  processed_at
) VALUES (
  {{ $('Split Courses').all().length }},
  {{ $('Categorize Items').all().length }},
  {{ $('Build Digest').first().json.unsubmitted_total }},
  {{ $('Build Digest').first().json.due_soon_total }},
  '{{ $('Post to Slack').first().json.ok === true ? 'success' : 'failed' }}',
  NOW()
)
RETURNING id, run_timestamp;
